name: acme
creator: a warm, relatable American woman in her fifties, with shoulder-length brown hair worn down and a soft blue cardigan
voice: a warm, slightly husky female voice, a calm and honest conversational delivery and a General American accent
setting: her bright kitchen in soft morning light, standing at the counter
details: fridge magnets and a school photo on the fridge behind her
a dish rack with two mugs by the sink
a phone charger cable on the counter
light: soft daylight from a window on the left, mixed with the warm ceiling light

props.name: jar
props.desc: a plain white unlabeled pill jar
props.where: stands on the counter in front of her, in the lower right of the frame

hands: Her phone hand stretches toward the lens at the lower left edge of the frame; that phone is the camera. Her free hand rests on the counter beside the jar.

beats.say: Okay, real talk, most magnesium I tried did nothing for me.
beats.action: gives a deadpan look straight into the lens, one eyebrow slowly rising

beats.say: So I stopped guessing and started reading labels.
beats.action: leans in a little toward the lens, her free hand resting on the counter

takes.soundscape: Quiet kitchen room tone in the morning, a faint fridge hum, birds faint outside the window, a soft rustle of her cardigan.
takes.end_state: she holds a dry, serious look into the lens with her lips together, her free hand resting on the counter beside the jar

steps: her free hand closes around the jar and lifts it a few inches off the counter
she gives the jar one short, hard shake
she sets the jar back down on the counter in the same spot
she opens her fingers and lays her hand flat on the counter beside the jar

takes.soundscape: Quiet kitchen room tone in the morning.
takes.end_state: she looks into the lens with a dry, serious face, her lips together, her free hand resting on the counter beside the jar

props.name: jar
props.desc: a plain white unlabeled pill jar
props.where: stands upright on the counter in the lower right of the frame

takes.hands: Her phone hand stretches toward the lens at the lower left edge of the frame; that phone is the camera. Her free hand holds the bottle (<Picture 1>) up beside her face, label facing the lens.

beats.say: This is the one I actually kept taking.
beats.action: holds the bottle (<Picture 1>) steady beside her face, label to the lens

beats.say: Here is what is on the label.
beats.action: holds the bottle still beside her face with a small honest smile

takes.setting: the driver's seat of her parked car on a gray afternoon
takes.camera_where: the dashboard in front of her
details: a supermarket parking lot through the windshield
a paper coffee cup in the cup holder
takes.light: flat overcast daylight through the windshield
takes.hands: Both her hands rest on the bottom of the steering wheel.

beats.say: Um, so I sat in the parking lot for ten minutes...
beats.action: looks into the lens with a tired face, both hands on the steering wheel

beats.say: just reading magnesium labels on my phone.
beats.action: lifts her right hand off the wheel and rubs her forehead slowly

takes.soundscape: Muffled car interior, faint traffic and a car door closing far away in the parking lot.
takes.end_state: she looks into the lens with a tired, serious face, her lips together, both hands back on the steering wheel
